description: Valencia Crossroads is a premier community shopping center strategically positioned at the intersection of two of Valencia's busiest streets in Santa Clarita, California, directly across from a regional mall. This 179,678 square foot open-air center serves as a vital retail hub for the affluent Santa Clarita Valley community, anchored by two powerhouse retailers: Whole Foods Market and Kohl's department store. The center benefits from exceptional visibility and accessibility along Valencia Boulevard, capturing strong daytime business from the area's substantial working population of over 131,000 within three miles. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center REIT, Valencia Crossroads exemplifies the company's Fresh Look® philosophy of creating thriving neighborhood destinations. With nearly 3 million annual visits, the center has established itself as a go-to destination for quality grocery shopping, fashion retail, and everyday conveniences, serving one of Southern California's most desirable and fastest-growing communities where average household incomes exceed $169,000 and home values approach $1 million.
